purpose: Prevent a freight journey from being marked ready until identity, vehicle, route, verified hazard, connectivity and security checks have been evaluated.
rules: Do not invent hazard, vehicle-health, emergency or security data.
Identity and authorization failures block departure.
Missing live hazard feed cannot be represented as a clean safety clearance.
Connectivity degradation is surfaced and does not by itself imply danger.
A provisional demo assessment must remain visibly marked DEMO/PROVISIONAL.
